instruction: Delete all .pdf files from my file system ~/downloads folder.
test_report:
Total: 3 tests, 3 passed, 0 failed

PASSED TESTS:
  [PASS] assert answers match.
  [PASS] assert model changes match file_system.File.
  [PASS] obtain deleted file_system.File records using models.changed_records.
assert all deleted files' paths match private_data.file_paths_with_extension (ignoring order)

arguments.code:
file_system_password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
file_system_username = 'jefsmith@gmail.com'
print('Using file_system username:', file_system_username)
res = apis.file_system.login(username=file_system_username, password=file_system_password)
print(res)
file_system_token = res.get('access_token')
print('token_present:', bool(file_system_token))

downloads_list = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path='~/downloads', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
print('type:', type(downloads_list))
print('len:', len(downloads_list))
print('sample:', downloads_list[:50])

pdf_paths = [p for p in downloads_list if isinstance(p,str) and p.lower().endswith('.pdf')]
print('total_files_listed:', len(downloads_list))
print('pdf_count:', len(pdf_paths))
print('pdf_paths:', pdf_paths)

delete_results = []
for fp in pdf_paths:
    try:
        r = apis.file_system.delete_file(file_path=fp, access_token=file_system_token)
        delete_results.append({"file_path": fp, "success": True, "message": r.get('message', '')})
    except Exception as e:
        delete_results.append({"file_path": fp, "success": False, "error": str(e)})

success_count = sum(1 for x in delete_results if x.get('success'))
fail_count = len(delete_results) - success_count
print('deleted_attempts:', len(delete_results))
print('success_count:', success_count)
print('fail_count:', fail_count)
print('failures:', [x for x in delete_results if not x.get('success')])

remaining = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_token, directory_path='~/downloads', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
remaining_pdf_paths = [p for p in remaining if isinstance(p,str) and p.lower().endswith('.pdf')]
print('remaining_files_listed:', len(remaining))
print('remaining_pdf_count:', len(remaining_pdf_paths))
print('remaining_pdf_paths:', remaining_pdf_paths)
